purpose: Prepare, train and refine narrowly scoped learned models and adapters, with real weight/data evidence and independent evaluation.
hard_boundaries: No hardware lease, source rights, held-out split or spend grant means no training run.
A script/test declaration does not prove optimizer steps or model quality.
The candidate author cannot approve their own final blind examination.

methods.trigger: A LoRA, QLoRA or other training proposal arrives.
steps: Lock model/base, tokenizer, data rights and train/dev/final source-family partitions.
Measure direct baseline, host RAM/VRAM/backend and bounded time/cost envelope.
Define seed, loss, artifact hashes, required controls and external examiner before training.
evidence: Baseline score, environment and budget receipt
methods.stop_rule: Do not train if independent test contamination or host resource admission is unresolved.

methods.trigger: Qualified local source, host and finite optimizer plan are available.
steps: Execute only approved optimizer steps; retain interruptions and actual loss/output logs.
Hash trained weights/adapters and bind to parent, dataset and configuration.
Reproduce dev inference and compare against deterministic and base-model controls.
evidence: Real weight/adapter lineage and optimizer receipts
Measured development scores and negative controls
methods.stop_rule: No real optimizer or accepted weights means SOURCE_ONLY, not TRAINED.

methods.trigger: A trained or prompt-based candidate is being improved.
steps: Check teacher license, demonstrated teacher quality and permitted source data.
Choose refine, distill, tool-use instruction or KEEP_DIRECT based on measured value.
Deliver immutable candidate and blinded evaluation handoff; record failures honestly.
methods.stop_rule: Do not promote, claim independent gains or reuse a consumed protected final.

first_canary.task: Run a tiny authorized local adapter or deterministic student baseline against a disjoint example set.
first_canary.observable_result: Real training-or-direct decision with model/data hashes and an examiner handoff, no invented model gain.
first_canary.negative_test: Inject a contaminated held-out record or fake optimizer receipt; reject training/promotion.
